title: Pass on the trip details

scenario.en: Your friend went to Alexandria and told you about it. Another friend wants to know the details.
scenario.ar: صاحبك رجع من إسكندرية وحكالك. صاحب تاني عايز يعرف التفاصيل.

source: "We went to Alexandria by train. We left at six and arrived at nine. The hotel was cheap. We ate fish on the beach, and we came back on Sunday."

task.en: Tell your other friend the main points.

key_points.en: They went to Alexandria by train.
They left at six and arrived at nine.

model_answer.en: They went to Alexandria by train. They left at six and arrived at nine. The hotel was cheap, they ate fish on the beach, and they came back on Sunday.
model_answer.ar: سافروا إسكندرية بالقطر، مشيوا ستة ووصلوا تسعة. الفندق كان رخيص، وأكلوا سمك على البحر، ورجعوا الأحد.
